l1_station_block.scale: platform-door cabin door ~2.2 m high (100 px at the block face, 45.5 px/m) [inf scale, +-15 %]
l1_station_block.note: photo l1 (Garage A station from the east): a separate low block over both tracks, its top 11.1 m above the AirTrain walkway, two long dark slots at +6.5 m (one over the south overhang, one over the north portal; none over the central pier), the south part on two round columns (open under the soffit at +3.1 m); sky above the block: any part of the garage higher than the block stands >= 27 m behind its east face (camera ~30 m east of the face, eye +1.6 m). The curved NE garage wall next to it: a first reading of ~12.0 m above the walkway (~31.8 m) was withdrawn after the camera-matched comparison (render_landside view_l1: camera 28 m east of the face, the block width matched to 0.2 %): the 12.0-m reading took the receding left edge of the curved wall for its top; with the ring at 39.6 the rendered curved end reaches the frame top as in the photo - no conflict, the ring stays [unk, BL-03]

i2_drums.scale: drum diameter 32.4 m across 185 px (5.7 px/m) [obs BL-02 B R 16.2]
i2_drums.note: photo i2 (from the AirTrain west of the garages, looking east): both drums in smooth light metal panels with five long horizontal dark slots and an open band near the top; white precast stair / elevator towers with small square windows at both ends of each drum, rising ~3 m above the drum ring; the long faces: continuous perforated screen panels

l5_camera.tower_D_src: SFO Museum RCC station polygon: round lobe x -2282.8..-2278.1 at z -1076..-1071.6 [obs]
